titles: Arrow keys still move the demo

keys.check: SPEC 6.2: the page calls preventDefault() on every keydown in a window capture listener. App chords (Cmd+1/2/3, Cmd+Option+P, Cmd+F, Cmd+S, Cmd+Shift+E, Cmd+P, Cmd+Shift+Enter) must still run, because main takes them in before-input-event before the page sees them; Cmd+V and other chords pass through to the page.
keys.pageKeys: document.documentElement.dataset.pageKeys: the last 50 chords the page received, space-separated, modifiers first (e.g. 'ArrowRight Meta+v')
keys.pageKeyCount: document.documentElement.dataset.pageKeyCount: keydown events that reached the page
keys.expectAfterAppChord: an app chord is absent from pageKeys and does not change pageKeyCount; ArrowRight still moves the deck
